C0936.title: Vcredit FinTech Assists Police in Dismantling Illegal 'Agent Rights Protection' Criminal Case
C0936.summary: According to reporting in January 2024, Vcredit FinTech assisted Shanghai police in handling a criminal case involving a black-market 'proxy rights protection' operation. The report said Xu and others impersonated borrowers' relatives and profited by applying complaint pressure and demanding compensation; the people involved were arrested in August 2023 and convicted of extortion in October. The report also described a related risk in which Miao, instigated by an illegal agency, repeatedly complained under the pretext of improper collection and refused to repay debts to several consumer finance platforms.
